derivation: Simple Music sells nothing yet: sheets, the disc press and discs are crafted from Vanilla materials; custom discs carry player uploads and must never be traded by villagers.

excluded.simplemusic:sheet_music: Crafted from paper, an ink sac and a feather.
excluded.simplemusic:blank_disc: Crafted from coal, blackstone and an amethyst shard.
excluded.simplemusic:custom_disc: Only made by burning an upload onto a blank disc.
excluded.simplemusic:guide_book: Crafted from a book and a note block.
